acceptanceCriteria: DOGFOOD.md records the destination order and requires each friction finding to name the earliest layer chosen and why a lower layer was not.
The recorded friction findings of the last three dogfood-sealed changes are classified against the order, and any finding that became instruction prose but fits an earlier layer is filed as a ticket.
If a fingerprint is added to self-observations, the change cites SOL-V0 requirements and does not feed ranking, evidence or authority.
body: Dogfood friction findings and operator corrections currently tend to become instruction prose. Lesson 46 of the source orders destinations: test or evaluation, scope or permission policy, automation, canonical example plus validator, instruction with a scenario check, human decision record; and deduplicates repeated corrections by a stable fingerprint. `self-observations.jsonl` is a candidate carrier for the fingerprint but must stay outside ranking, evidence and authority (invariant 4). Source: rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch, Phase 14 agent-workbench track, reviewed 2026-09-24.
title: dogfood: route each friction finding to the earliest layer that prevents recurrence
